text: Pedro and Fiona are getting married on 12 June 2027 in Porto. Save-the-dates go out after Christmas, apparently.
Joanna's dad had a fall on Sunday and broke his wrist. He's home now, but she's doing all the driving and shopping for him. I should check in with her later this week.
Emil proposed to Kate! Sometime last weekend, on a beach in Cornwall. Need to send them a card.
Ryan's daughter has had a temperature since Tuesday. He's working from home until she's better.
Abdi and Shanice's tenth anniversary is on 3 March 2027. He wants to surprise her with a long weekend in Lisbon and has asked me to keep it quiet.

Called Jun. His knee surgery is booked for 18 November 2026 and he's honestly quite nervous about it, mostly the general anaesthetic. His wife will drive him in that morning. Remind me to message him the day before, and to ring him the next day to see how it went.
Idris says the wedding is off. He and Cem split up a few weeks ago. He sounded okay, but I'm going to ring him on Friday.
Liam's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. He's flying back to Dublin tomorrow and doesn't know how long he'll stay.
Jack and Hemi are thinking about getting engaged in the spring. Hemi has been dropping hints about a vintage ring.
Remember that Joseph is coeliac when we book somewhere for his anniversary dinner.
Varun's son broke his arm at football on Saturday. He's in plaster for six weeks, so no swimming until after Christmas.

Camila is maid of honour at her sister Phoebe's wedding on 7 November 2026. She's writing the speech and is terrified of standing up in front of two hundred people. She practised a bit of it on me and it's genuinely funny. Text her good luck that morning, and ask how it went the day after.
Picked up the dry cleaning and booked the car in for its MOT. Still need to sort the boiler service sometime next month.
Aurelio's grandmother passed away on Thursday. The funeral is in Naples sometime next week. Must send flowers.
Pieter and his wife Suzanne renewed their vows in August. They showed me the photos; it looked lovely.
Zhang has been signed off work with a slipped disc. He's bored and fed up. Pop round with some books soon.
Kerry's wedding to Ignacio has been moved from May to September 2027 because the venue double-booked. She's livid.
Salma's little boy Tobi has chickenpox, so they've cancelled his birthday party on Saturday. Drop a present round for him the week after.
Ava got engaged to Javier over the weekend! The engagement party will be sometime in January. I should get them something nice.
Lindiwe is back from the hospital. Her MRI showed nothing serious, so she's relieved. Physio starts after half term.

Niamh Walsh mentioned that her parents' 40th wedding anniversary is in March 2027. She and her brother Liam are organising a surprise dinner for them and want to keep it small, just family and a few old friends from their church. Her mum is vegetarian and her dad hates anything spicy. Send her a couple of restaurant ideas by the weekend.
Ask Pedro how his dad's heart scan went. It was on Monday.

Shanice is struggling. Her mum was diagnosed with early dementia in the summer, and Shanice is doing most of the caring on top of a full-time job. She cried a bit on the phone, which isn't like her at all. Her brother lives in Leeds and doesn't help much. Call her this weekend and offer to take her out for lunch.
Hemi's dog Rolo had an operation on his leg yesterday. He's on bed rest for a fortnight and hating the cone.
Wedding admin: suit fitting for Emil's wedding on 14 August 2027, and the stag do is in Kraków sometime in the spring. I've already paid my deposit for the flat.
Jun says he's been feeling much better since starting the new medication. He's even back at the climbing wall.
Ryan Brennan, Bren to everyone at work, is getting married in Galway next summer. Invites should arrive after Christmas.

Coffee with Kate. Her mum's hip replacement is on 9 December 2026, and Kate is taking two weeks off to look after her afterwards. She's worried because her mum lives alone and is stubborn about asking for help. Her partner Joseph will cover the school run. Need to text her the day before the operation and check in again a week after.
Idris loves old Italian films and keeps saying he wants to visit Cinecittà someday.
Varun and his wife celebrate 25 years married in February 2027. He's thinking of a watch for her and would like help choosing one.
Fiona's toddler has been up all night with an ear infection. She sounded exhausted on the phone.
Note to self: dentist on 4 November 2026, then haircut the day after.
Abdi sprained his ankle at five-a-side last night. He's out for a few weeks, which means he'll miss the cup final on 15 November 2026.
Joanna and Pieter's engagement party has been cancelled. Pieter's dad is unwell and they don't want to go ahead without him there.
Cem is having his wisdom teeth out on Thursday morning. He hates dentists. Message him that evening to see how he's doing.
Zhang Wang and his partner are expecting their first baby in the spring. They found out at the twelve-week scan last week.
Aurelio said his sister Camila has just got engaged. The wedding will probably be in Brazil, sometime in 2028.
Don't forget to sign the card for Kerry's leaving do on Friday. She's going part time to look after her dad after his stroke.
Lovely chat with Salma. Nothing much new; she's still loving her pottery class and the allotment.
Tobi's mum rang. His tonsillectomy went well yesterday and he's allowed home tomorrow. He keeps asking for ice cream and Lego.
Jack and his wife Niamh are going to Japan for their anniversary sometime in April. He wants restaurant recommendations from me.

Suzanne's husband had a mild heart attack last month. He's recovering well, but she's anxious about leaving him on his own, even for an hour. She's cut her hours at the library to stay close. Remind me to ask after him when I see her on Wednesday.
Ignacio thinks Javier is about to propose. Apparently he's been quietly asking about Ava's ring size.

Pedro rang about Fiona's dad. He was admitted on Sunday with a chest infection and they're keeping him in until at least the end of the week. Fiona's been at the hospital every day and isn't sleeping. Wedding planning is on hold, though 12 June 2027 is still the date. I must send her something to cheer her up, maybe a food delivery, and check in with Pedro next week.
Emil's fiancée Lindiwe has glandular fever. She's had to postpone her exams until the new year.
Bought flowers for Gran. I'm visiting her on Sunday afternoon with the kids.
Liam's twins start nursery in January. His wife goes back to work the week after.
Ryan says Camila's broken toe is healing nicely. She should be out of the boot by mid-November.

Hemi and Jack's wedding is on 21 August 2027 in Wellington. Hemi wants us to fly out early and stay for a week afterwards so we can see a bit of the country. Jack's mum is doing the flowers herself. Need to look at flights after Christmas, before prices go up.
Joseph has been off with long Covid since the summer. He seems low. Invite him round for dinner soon.
Remind me to get Abdi and Shanice an anniversary present. Shanice mentioned she'd love a proper coffee grinder.
Kate Murphy, Katie from running club, is recovering from a stress fracture in her foot. She's gutted to be missing the Dublin marathon.

Javier's mum gets her biopsy results on 28 October 2026. He's trying not to think about it and kept changing the subject, but he admitted he hasn't been sleeping. His sister is flying over from Madrid the day before to be with them. Text him that afternoon, and maybe drop round the weekend after.
Dr Barros rang. My blood test results are fine; follow-up appointment sometime in the new year.
Uncle Idris turns seventy in March 2027 and wants a quiet family lunch rather than a party.
Shanice's brother Liam got married in Accra last weekend. She said the celebrations went on for three days. Ask her for photos.
Varun's daughter is in hospital with appendicitis. The surgery was this morning and went smoothly. He'll be off work until next week. Message him tomorrow.
Heads up from Ava: the reunion has been called off. Nobody could agree on a date.

Zhang's parents celebrate their golden anniversary on 30 May 2027. The whole family is planning a big dinner in Shanghai, and he's going over for two weeks around it. His dad has been unwell this year, so it means a lot to them. He'd like a nice photo album as a gift, if I see one.
Phoebe and Tobi have been together five years today. They're keeping it low-key with a takeaway and a film.
